subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Which durable subagent completion delivery policy should own this umbrella issue before more automated fix PRs are queued?
rationale: The bug is source-backed and currently affecting users, but the permanent fix changes retry durability, visible failure semantics, timeout/restart behavior, and duplicate-prevention across agent and channel surfaces.

options.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and define a durable outbox, spool, or equivalent state machine before accepting partial retry changes.

options.title: Narrow to linked retry PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90561 as the near-term fix, require live requester-visible proof, and split remaining restart/timeout/dedupe gaps into follow-ups.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Close or demote this umbrella only after maintainers move each remaining failure mode to clearly owned narrower issues.

recommendation.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and define a durable outbox, spool, or equivalent state machine before accepting partial retry changes.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest visible history across the agent runtime, subagent docs, and delivery-state boundaries that define the product decision.
